answer: A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 125 aliases means authoring 125 texts that each match their own nonce. Because the derivation is bound to the saffron signature, the ledge gate rejects a mismatch, and the glacier checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 118 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
